## Setup

- Follow the `tasks` skill: `tasks prime`, start before changes, CLI-only task edits, `tasks check` before commits, and completion on the task's branch before it merges.
- Work in a task worktree under the main checkout's .worktrees directory (`work-link --ensure .worktrees`, `git worktree add`, and `git worktree lock`).
- Run `just setup` immediately after creating a worktree. It links the .worktrees directory, installs the sole runtime npm dependency (`jsonc-parser`, used only by `relay install`) plus development-only TypeScript and Node 22 types, and sets the Dropbox ignore attribute on `node_modules`.
- Install `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` in a new clone so hooks run through the vendored `ops` front door.

## Gates

- Use `just test-one <file>` or `just test-one --test-name-pattern "<regex>" <file>` while working; arguments pass intact to `node --test`.
- Run fresh focused checks for changed behavior and `just check-hygiene` (`ops-check`, `ops-docs check`, and `tasks check`) before committing or integrating.
- After editing `identity.toml`, `README.md`, or `AGENTS.md`, run `just docs` (`python3 tools/ops-docs write`) so the generated identity and family blocks stay synchronized.
- The invoking code root's `.tt.toml` (`automatic_broad = false`) disables routine broad local checks (`test`, `test-fast`, `check-code`); a missing policy file means enabled. Do not rerun broad targets solely for a commit or gate. Policy skips are not passing tests.
- Use `just test-full` to force the full test suite, and `TT_FORCE=1 just check` to force strict `tsc --checkJs --noEmit` across `src/`, `bin/`, and `test/types/`. Read `docs/test-execution-policy.md` for current activation state and coverage gaps. Fast and full commands intentionally run the same suite.
- Test the Node 22 floor as well as the development runtime. The suite includes a local tarball install/CLI smoke test (`test/pack.test.js`) and real Linux IPC/process tests.
- Before removing a worktree, harvest its timing logs with `tt-report`.

## Layout

- `identity.toml` — Guild identity manifest (`authority` and `[documents] references`); rendered into `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` by `tools/ops-docs`.
- `src/types.js` — Shared JSDoc contracts; preserve runtime validation at JSON boundaries. `test/types/` holds compile-time contract checks, never runtime tests.
- `docs/api.md`, `docs/registry.md`, `docs/adapters.md`, `docs/questions.md` — Shipped reference contracts.
- `docs/runbooks/inbox-service.md`, `docs/runbooks/registry-lock-repair.md` — Shipped operator runbooks.
- `docs/test-execution-policy.md`, `docs/runbooks/hook-install-rollback.md`, `docs/runbooks/hook-qualification.md`, `docs/runbooks/answer-route-probes.md`, `docs/runbooks/codex-question-reproof.md`, `docs/runbooks/darwin-probe.md`, `docs/runbooks/release.md` — Repository-only contributor and developer guides (not shipped in the npm tarball; shipped Markdown files must not link to them with relative Markdown links).

## Rules

- Planned work requires reviewed specs and plans before implementation. Reuse the approved extraction spec in `ops`; `tasks` identity has a separate design gate.
- New design specs, implementation plans, briefs, and handoffs go under the project's detached records directory (`records relay/docs/specs/`, `records relay/docs/plans/`, `records relay/docs/notes/`), committed in the `records` repository, never in this tree. Reference documents tracked in this tree (`docs/*.md`, `docs/runbooks/*.md`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`) are revised in place.
- Use conventional commits without AI attribution.
- Runtime: Node >=22, ES modules, Node built-ins. No presentation dependencies.
- GitHub owner is `khughitt`; check the active `gh` account (`gh auth status`) before every `gh` write.
- Never enable the extracted OpenCode plugin or register a live hook until the installation and capability gates pass.
